label: Early original-phase steps (t<=2): input o/e/l/n, or step 1 after certain first tokens
explanation: Positional reset-gate unit for the start of the sequence. 93% of activation mass is in the original phase at t<=2; t=1 alone holds 66% of mass and has a 37% firing rate. Inside that window it depends on the token: inputs o, e, l, n fire at about 4x base rate (g, w, h less), and at t=1 it also fires after first tokens such as l, 3, q, x, v. Almost silent from t>=3 in the original phase and in the copy phase. There is a secondary mode on <DEL> in short sequences (L=3, i.e. the delimiter right after the t<=2 window), and these include the largest activations (top examples are <DEL> after 2-3 tokens, e.g. m i l <DEL>). The exact token-by-position interaction is not fully captured: dev F1 is about 0.69 and mass recall 0.81.
